description: This file contains functions to fetch project names from an API endpoint, utilizing axios for HTTP requests. It includes a main function 'fetchProjectNameDirect' and a deprecated alias 'fetchProjectNameByProjectId', both designed to retrieve project names given a project ID, with fallback mechanisms and error handling.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the project name directly from the API using either a client or fallback axios GET request, given a project ID.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId(projectId)
methods.description: Deprecated alias for fetchProjectNameDirect, retained for backward compatibility.
